title: Yummy Tangy Kenyan Meat Kebabs
description: A crowd-pleasing Kenyan dish featuring coriander leaves and pickle, this recipe is paleo-friendly and perfect for any occasion. The combination of tangy and gooey flavors will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 200 degrees Celsius.
In a large bowl, combine the beef strips, coriander leaves, pickle, onion, garlic, and ginger.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tomato paste, coconut milk, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the tomato paste mixture over the beef mixture and mix well to combine.
Thread the beef mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional coriander leaves if desired.
